description: Web copies derived from original validation visualizations; original files preserved.

encoding.timing: Original variable frame presentation timestamps, frame counts and time base preserved exactly. Historical container duration headers inconsistent with their encoded timeline are normalized to final presentation timestamp plus the source final-frame packet duration; original and derivative durations are recorded per video. B-frames are disabled and obsolete input edit lists are ignored so every original frame is retained. Paired output durations match. Faststart enabled.
